title: Plot a calendar's structure as an icicle — calendar_autoplot
text: x Calendar (plot()). type "icicle" (default) "stack" — axonometric stacked-planes view (see ). fill drives fill gradient: "order" (chronological position, default), "share", "weight". color_pattern fill = "order": "within" (default) restarts gradient inside parent timeslice (hours recycle every day); "global" sweeps across whole year. labels Segment labels. Icicle: "name" (level value, e.g. h00; default), "timeslice" (full path, e.g. Q1_h00), "none"; TRUE/FALSE accepted shorthands. type = "stack": character vector timeframes whose member names drawn plane's segments (e.g. labels = "SEASON"); unset = none. max_labels Rows segments get labels. Default 60. max_segments Rows segments binned x-midpoint drawing (fill = width-weighted mean), keeping hourly calendars fast. Default 2000. border Rectangle border color. Default NA (none), dense rows render smooth gradients. palette Viridis option letter name ("D"/"viridis", "C"/"plasma", "B", "", "E", "turbo"...). Default "D". type = "stack" also accepts NULL: fill scale added, can supply (e.g. energypal scale). annual Include ANNUAL root band. Default TRUE. view type = "stack" : predefined point view – "oblique" (shear/depth default), "top-", "cavalier", "cabinet", "military", "isometric", "dimetric", "trimetric", "perspective" (receding planes shrink). angle, ratio type = "stack" : oblique view angle (degrees receding axis) foreshortening ratio – e2 = ratio * (cos(angle), sin(angle)). Overridden view. shear, depth, gap type = "stack" : raw receding-axis components (e2 = (shear, depth); used neither view angle/ratio given) vertical spacing planes. gap = NULL (default) spaces planes almost touching, slight overlap (0.85 x plane's screen height). rotate type = "stack" : -plane rotation plane (degrees, counter-clockwise) projection. direction type = "stack" : "" (default) stacks coarsest timeframe top; "" puts bottom. colour, linewidth type = "stack" : segment border colour width, recycled across planes (one entry per plane styles individually). Defaults "grey35" 0.2 – ggplot2's sf polygon border. (icicle's rectangle border separate border argument.) frame type = "stack" : draw plane's outline (unit box run projection) guide. TRUE uses "grey80", colour string uses colour, NULL (default) draws frames. frame_fill type = "stack" : fill plane sheets; best mostly transparent, e.g. frame_fill = ggplot2::alpha("grey60", 0.12). Setting fill draws frames even without frame; NA (default) = fill. connectors type = "stack" : dashed lines joining corresponding frame corners adjacent planes. TRUE uses frame colour, colour string picks ; default FALSE. data, z Colour figure value instead structure: works types – icicle fills band's rectangles, stack fills plane. data data.frame timeslice column calendar's resolution (calendar-named label column) plus value column named z; every timeframe gets value recast resolution, whole figure shares one continuous fill scale (legend title via labs(fill = )). icicle, data overrides fill/color_pattern, dense bands binned width-weighted means. rule data: aggregation rule per-timeframe recasts ("sum", "mean", "weighted_mean", ... – see recast_calendar(); explicit registered, never guessed). year data: model year recast routes (required recast_calendar()). data: base-grid granularity per-timeframe recasts. Defaults "hour" – always correct (automatic choice can pick daily grid sub-daily calendars, silently collapses hour-type slices). ...
